baseline.method: Original Photutils 2.3.0 ImagePSF + constant sky, Astropy 8.0.2 bounded TRF fit on bundled GLIMPSE crops

definitions.position_error: maximum Euclidean position discrepancy across four sources, pixel
definitions.flux_relative_error: maximum abs(estimate-reference)/reference across four strictly positive amplitudes
definitions.observation_relative_l2: L2 of fitted image minus public observations divided by L2 of observations, all four patches; no mask, registration or rescaling

provenance: Frozen before local extraction. Double-precision original reruns identical; float32 effective-PSF rounding sensitivity measured independently. Nonzero tolerances exceed measured precision differences. Observation bound 0.12 is 1.1 times original residual rounded upward; instrumental-model discrepancy remains, so this evaluates reproduction of the adopted model rather than independent astrophysical truth.
